name: John Francis Bloxam
bio: An undergraduate of Exeter College, Oxford, who founded and edited The Chameleon and wrote for its first and only issue, anonymously, 'The Priest and the Acolyte' - a story of a priest's love for a boy. The story was widely attributed to Wilde, and much was made of it at his trial. Wilde, who had aphorisms in the same issue, described its author privately as 'an undergraduate of strange beauty'.
bio_note: No letters between them survive (no entry in the Index of Recipients); the evidence is a sentence in Wilde's letter to Ada Leverson, printed 625. Dates not recorded.
